name: NCLEX-RN Prep: Wardmere
subtitle: NCLEX-RN practice, NGN items
shortDescription: Adaptive NCLEX-RN practice: original questions with rationales, Next Generation item types, case studies and a CAT-style mock. No account.
longDescription:
NCLEX-RN Prep: Wardmere helps nursing graduates practise for the NCLEX-RN with original questions, clear rationales and a study plan that adapts to you. It works offline, with no account.

### Built From the Published Test Plan
- All 149 activity statements in the 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan have at least 8 original questions with rationales, across all eight content areas.
- 82 short lessons cover the plan's sample content (512 content points mapped to lessons). Coverage screen shows exactly what is covered and how you are doing on each activity.
- Every item type: multiple choice, select all that apply, bow-tie, matrix, trend, highlight, cloze drop-down, drag and drop, and ordered response.
- 14 unfolding patient case studies that walk through the six steps of clinical judgment.

### Learn and Adapt
- A 40-question diagnostic finds your weak areas and sets your first plan.
- Wrong answers link straight to the lesson you need, and spaced review brings missed questions back at the right time.
- A CAT-style mock follows the published rules (85 to 150 items, five hours, 95 percent confidence stop). It is our own rough estimator, a study guide and not a prediction.
- Switch between the Test plan view and the Patient cases view at any time.

### Labs and Reference
- Dose calculation trainer, IV rate and drip chamber, Glasgow Coma Scale, lab value explorer, ABG interpreter, vital-sign trend monitor, delegation board, handoff builder and care-plan builder.
- Original, cited reference tables: lab values, vital signs by age, scales, medication safety, isolation precautions, milestones, IV fluids.

### Readable and Honest
- Text zoom from 50 to 300 percent, large clear type, tablet layouts that use the whole screen.
- Every lesson and rationale cites public sources (OpenStax, CDC, NIH, AHRQ, FDA, WHO and more). Questions are original; no real exam items are used. Content is for education, not medical advice.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
